title: Existing MCP search guidance uses a rejected argument
detail: An existing tools-enabled session can retain earlier launch guidance after update, including shared Codex on resume. The guidance names words for seed_search. At pinned f02c67f39 MCP refuses words before search; the same caller succeeds with query. Preserve a usable search path for already-running sessions while teaching query. The implementation seed chose a single advertised name with no alias, so keep that constraint in view when selecting the fix. Independent wire proof is on s-awz1s3.
